We are travelwithkids_india , organising trips for moms and kids and completing 5 years in the industry. 
.
We are often asked if my child will have a same age child for company. 
.
But we believe in the mix age group - 
The beauty is when the older one leads.. the beauty is when the younger one keenly observes.. 
The beauty is when the older one learns patience.. the beauty is when the younger one learns from the older ones!
.
.
Here is one such example.. In the video are 13 and 1 year old playing in the sand and laughing their hearts out! 
..
